review.note: Extracted as text from the old lesson (which has no data/ or lib/ data file; its content lives in components/SurahData.ts and the components), then reviewed against the verified dataset. A line with "review" set is held (not shown) until a teacher resolves it. NUMBERING: the old lesson's 17 entries are exactly the surah's 17 ayat, all present. Dropped: the four Tajweed rules and the two Tajweed questions of the final quiz (Tajweed comes only from the reviewed dataset), the full-surah and per-ayah audio URLs and the reciter line, the typed basmala of the listening page, and every hand-typed Quran string (replaced by positions). In the final quiz, the first-ayah question's "bismillah" option and the two complete-the-ayah questions' hand-typed distractors were replaced by ayat and words of this surah (each flagged CHANGED), and the four meaning questions were cut before the quoted word, which is now a position. The old quiz categories were mapped (hifz, ma'ani). The complete-the-ayah words are the answers of the old complete-the-ayah and missing-word games, de-duplicated (al-thaqib is in both); their hand-typed distractors (wa-l-nas, wa-l-fajr, al-kabir, al-saghir, nasir, qadir, jamil, kabir, bil-haqq, bil-khayr, al-falaq, al-nas, al-'azim, al-karim, khalqihi, amrihi, al-anhar, al-ashjar, al-mu'minin, al-salihin) are gone, as the game draws its options from these words. The intro is the three lines of the old intro card joined with "، ". Each lesson learned is its old title and description joined with ": "; the lessons and the reflection come from the non-Tajweed steps of components/TajweedSection.tsx. The reflection ideas are the old answer choices. Emoji were stripped from the ends of lines. Not carried (no field or no such game in the engine): the welcome card, the ayah-count and surah-number cards, the intro quiz (surah name, ayah count), the ayah-ordering, start-end memory and build-the-ayah games, the two word-meaning games (same words and meanings as the list), the encouragement lines, the reflection's feedback line, and the result lines. Matching aids, for alignment only and never stored: the old text writes adraka (2:2) with a plain alif where the Uthmani text has alif maqsura and a dagger alif; the word card and quiz word al-tariq (typed with the kasra of ayah 1) were typed without the wa- of wa-l-tariq and point at the whole verse word (1:2), and the card al-hazl was typed without the bi- of bil-hazl (14:3).

intro.text: سورة الطارق سورة جميلة تذكرنا بعظمة خلق الله، تخبرنا أن الله خلق السماء والنجوم المضيئة، وأن الله يراقب أعمال الناس ويعلم كل شيء

tafsir.text: يُقسِم الله بالسماء وبالنجم الذي يأتي في الليل
وما أعلمك ما هذا النجم العظيم؟
هو النجم المضيء اللامع الذي يخترق الظلام بنوره
كل إنسان عليه ملائكة تحفظه وتكتب أعماله
يخرج هذا الماء من جسم الإنسان
إن الله قادر على إعادة خلق الإنسان مرة أخرى
يوم القيامة تُكشف كل الأسرار والأعمال
لن يكون للإنسان قوة ولا أحد يساعده يوم القيامة إلا عمله الصالح
tafsir.review: Adds "except his good deeds" ("illa 'amaluhu al-salih"), which the ayah does not say. Common tafsir: on that day man (the denier of the resurrection) has no strength of his own to resist and no helper to save him. Teacher to decide whether to keep the addition.

tafsir.text: يُقسم الله بالسماء التي تُنزل المطر مرة بعد مرة
والأرض التي تنشق فيخرج منها النبات
إن القرآن كلام حق يفرق بين الحق والباطل
وليس القرآن لعبًا بل هو كلام جاد وحقيقي
والله يُدبّر أمره وخطته أعظم من كل خطة
فاصبر يا محمد ولا تستعجل، فالله سيحاسبهم
tafsir.review: Addresses the Prophet as "ya Muhammad". The meaning is right (give the disbelievers respite, a little while), but the Quran never calls him by bare name, and tafsir for children usually says "ayyuha al-rasul" or "ya rasul Allah" (al-Muyassar: "fa-amhilhum ayyuha al-rasul"). Teacher to choose the wording.

words.meaning: المطر الذي يعود مرة بعد مرة

lessons.text: التأمل في خلق الله: نتأمل في السماء والنجوم ونعرف عظمة الله الخالق
الله يعلم كل شيء: الله يعلم ما نفعله وما نخفيه في قلوبنا
عمل الخير: يجب أن نعمل الخير دائمًا لأن الله يرانا
القرآن كلام حق: القرآن ليس لعبًا بل هو كلام الله الحق
الصبر والثقة بالله: نصبر ونثق بالله لأنه ينصر الحق دائمًا

reflection.question: ما الأشياء الجميلة التي خلقها الله في السماء والتي يمكننا أن نتفكر فيها؟

didYouKnow.text: هل تعلم أن النجوم تضيء السماء في الليل؟
هل تعلم أن الله يعلم كل ما نفعله؟
هل تعلم أن المطر ينزل من السماء ليُحيي الأرض؟
هل تعلم أن النباتات تخرج من شقوق الأرض؟
هل تعلم أن القرآن الكريم فيه 114 سورة؟
didYouKnow.review: True (the Quran has 114 surahs), but not something this surah teaches. Teacher to keep or drop.
